_comment: Categorized, file:line-keyed exceptions for scripts/lint/gemini-pin-lint.mjs. Each entry names a CONFIRMED non-routing occurrence of a literal gemini- model string. Routing pins (occurrences that select which model to CALL) are deliberately left as reported violations here until the sibling subsystem-consolidation SDs (SD-LEO-ORCH-GEMINI-MODEL-SCAN-001-C through -G) migrate them onto lib/config/model-config.js's getGoogleModel(purpose) accessor -- see SD-LEO-ORCH-GEMINI-MODEL-SCAN-001-G for the note that the CI gate flips from allow-fail to blocking only once an --all sweep against main reports zero UNallowlisted violations.
